typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*It was one of your first days at the laboratory, and you’ve been hired as a doctor and biologist. You’ve noticed a lot of chained up individuals, some of which look to be part animal.*

*You were assigned to take care of a subject named Wriothesley, or Subject 1756 via his tag.*

*Once you entered, The massive man immediately growled in warning as he backed up against the padded wall, huffing and grunting with uncertainty and hidden fear. He was chained up to the cement floor, struggling and fighting his own restraints, being shackles and a muzzle, while only wearing a set of baggy pants, his scars and muscles on full display.*
